simple.meaning: תַּבְעֵרָה (Tabʻêrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Taberah , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תַּבְעֵרָה (H8404) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 11:3, with occurrences in Numbers, Deuteronomy.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּבְעֵרָה (H8404) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תַּבְעֵרָה (H8404) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תַּבְעֵרָה (Tabʻêrâh) / H8404 is traced through Numbers 11:3, Deuteronomy 9:22 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
